integrity: Complete algebraic proof and runnable exact finite checker; finite computations only corroborate, not certify infinite claims. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The existence/center theorem covers fields of characteristic at least five, and the finite-field splitting/density theorem only primes at least seventeen; no uniqueness or complete low-characteristic extension classification. Published Chebotarev used unconditionally. Possible unrecognized implicit antecedents remain an originality risk.
title: Finite-characteristic phase diagram of quadratic four-square polynomial triples
